headline: Smart Fit Reports 40% Annual Profit Growth in Third Quarter
summary: Smart Fit (SMFT3) reported a recurring net profit of R$248 million for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40% increase compared to the same period last year, driven by rapid expansion and higher revenue per student.
why: Smart Fit is a major fitness chain in Latin America. Strong earnings growth reflects successful scaling and operational efficiency in the consumer services sector.
